entries.statement: The owner approves the specific release in chat. Routine code/UI updates follow the owner-managed Proxmox backup policy and retain code rollback, non-destructive publication and same-identity reconnect; actual stored-data migrations retain fresh verified backup, restoration rehearsal and state-parity gates.
entries.decision: Decisions/55-Owner Chat Approval for Tier B
externalPrerequisites: The owner's chat Go for this specific release, given after the change description or explicitly in advance; an agent cannot infer confirmation or carry approval into another release.

Checked code rollback, non-destructive publication and same-player reconnect for routine updates; fresh verified backup, restoration rehearsal and state parity for actual stored-data migrations. Proxmox backup setup remains the owner’s responsibility and is not asserted verified.
Stop and report any failed data-preservation check; chat approval does not waive these checks.
